comment: apply.c use_whip() whipattack (3128-3145): an Archeologist wearing a ring of warning flicks a bullwhip three times at an invisible soldier created to the north-west. Each flick finds !canspotmon() and tests glyph_is_invisible(levl[rx][ry].glyph); the report prints every time because display.c show_mon_or_warn() (489-493) forgets the remembered I whenever newsym() draws the warning number over it. Reaches the site; it does not tell the remembered glyph from the drawn one, which no recipe found does (see whip-flick-unseen-soldier-plane-of-water).
